item.title: Bullet holes, casings found at north end house - 89.9 The Wave
item.description: Police are investigating a north end shooting. They responded to a West Street residence yesterday at noon and found several holes in it, and shell casings outside. The incident is believed to have happened overnight. No one was hurt.

item.title: Former Halifax Mooshead Vuic sentenced for impaired driving - 89.9 The Wave
item.description: A former Mooseheads player has been sentenced for impaired driving. 21-year-old Brandon Vuic got a $1300 fine for the October 2014 incident in Dartmouth. He’d previously pleaded guilty to cocaine possession from the same night, getting a conditional discharge and year’s probation.

item.title: 645 charged by HRP, RCMP for impaired driving in 2016 - 89.9 The Wave
item.description: Halifax Regional Police and RCMP charged 645 people with impaired driving last year. 599 were busted for alcohol, 46 for drugs. 241 drivers were caught after people called 911 about them. Police encourage you to call if you suspect an impaired driver.
